external_collaboration.evidence_quote: AICOL Gold Coast English school accepts students from 12-17 years for High School Preparation (HSP) and from 6-12 years for Primary School (PSP) – with or without a parent/guardian. AICOL has an English Pathway Program (EPP) with EQI Schools and many Private Schools. No formal English test required for high school entry. Our intensive HSP course prepares students for direct entry into local school. Enter or exit anytime, no set 10-week blocks. Contact us!
